title: Lester Lewis and playing with Billy and De De
summary: Lester Lewis is still alive; Jiles played a year or two with Billy and De De at the Silver Star and Lutcher.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. What about Lester Lewis? Is he still alive?
Yeah he's still alive. I think he lives in the night ward but he don't play anymore. Yeah.
And how many jobs did you work with Billy and the D? You worked much with them?
Oh I worked years at the time, a year, two years. I played a lot of times with the D and Billy.

We played at the Silver Star, right on St. Bernard and St. Claude and perhaps you could get the name from her on Ramport near Canal. I played down at Lutcher with them and played, I mean jobs and houses, fraternity jobs and whatnot, a lot of jobs.
